Over time, the surface begins to peel away, revealing deeply layered crystalline strata within. These layers demonstrate a captivating, impossible movement: they defy gravitational pull, lifting and drifting in intricate, settled patterns that suggest forces far beyond the visible. The motion is intensely slow and geological, allowing the viewer to study the physics and color shifts of the sediment layers as they constantly reorganize in magnificent, counter-gravity displays.

statement: This sketch presents a geological structure that appears solid and immutable at first glance, but reveals its inner complexity over time. The scene depicts layers of crystalline strata beneath a concrete surface, each with distinct coloration and movement patterns. These layers exhibit counter-gravitational behavior—floating and drifting in slow, mesmerizing motions that suggest forces beyond normal physical laws. The floating particles represent sedimentary material that defies gravity, creating an ever-shifting landscape within the structure. The viewer is invited to observe these geological transformations unfold slowly, studying how color shifts and movement patterns continuously reorganize the composition in a way that feels both alien and intimately beautiful.
